english.note: A man uses this when he takes a wife, rather than the gender-neutral construction.
Use 娶 when the subject is a man taking a woman as his wife.

examples.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 ceoi2 zo2 go3 lou5 po4

examples.english: Ming finally got to marry the girl he loves.
examples.traditional: 阿明終於娶到佢心愛嘅女仔。
